# Star Kebab House — Pizza & Grill

> Authentic 100% Halal Turkish charcoal kebabs, Halal Snack Packs (HSP), stone-baked Turkish pides, gourmet pizzas, handmade gozleme, charcoal skewers, banquets, and baklava.

## Menu Highlights (100% Halal, AUD GST Included)
- **Kebab Rolls ($15–$16):** Chicken, Lamb/Beef, Mixed Meats, Zucchini (V), Falafel (V). Add chips & can drink for +$5.
- **Halal Snack Packs / HSP (Regular $18 / Large $22):** Chicken, Mixed, Lamb — served with golden chips, melted cheese, and up to 3 sauces.
- **Turkish Pides (Regular $16–$18 / Large $26–$28):** 14 traditional varieties including Spinach & Feta, Minced Lamb, Shaved Meat, Lahmacun, Meat Lover, and Aussie.
- **Gourmet Pizzas (Regular $5–$18 / Large $14–$28):** 30+ 100% Halal varieties including Garlic Prawn, Halloumi, Peri Peri Chicken, Tandoori Chicken, Moroccan Lamb, Meatlovers, and Zaatar.
- **Handmade Gozleme (Regular $16 / Large $26):** Chicken, Classic Cheese, Salami, Mix Lamb, Potato, Spinach & Feta.
- **Charcoal Mains & Skewers ($24–$31):** Chicken, Lamb, Beef & Mixed Skewers, Lamb Cutlets, Slow-Cooked Lamb Shanks, Borsa Kebab, Spiced Meatballs, Grilled Vegetables.
- **Lunch Boxes ($18–$22) & Turkish Burgers ($16):** Served in freshly baked Turkish bread/buns, including Beef, Grilled Chicken, Camel, and Vege Burgers.
- **Hot Entrees ($15) & Homemade Dips ($7):** Dolma Vine Leaves, Zucchini Balls, Falafel, Spring Rolls, Cucumber, Hummus, Garlic, Eggplant, Beetroot, Carrot, and Chilli dips.
- **Group Banquets ($70–$180):** 6 Turkish feast banquets for 2 to 6+ guests (from $25/person).
- **Desserts ($4–$4.50):** Pistachio, Almond, Walnut, and Chocolate Walnut Baklava, plus Semolina Cake.
